regions.summary: Map a valid shop cursor into an item slot and animate its two highlight sprites. The row loop shifts the offset once, then repeatedly subtracts $10 and adds five; JMP BA89 skips the initial LSR on later passes. Only 16 byte Y inputs terminate with stable RAM; the other 240 repeat. Y=$20/$40/$60/$80 yields rows 0/5/10/15. The twelve-cell contract additionally bounds the resulting index; arbitrary OAM coordinates are not safe inputs.

regions.summary: Compare actor top plus four with player top, set contact bit four when appropriate and clear bit six. Valid phase 0..15 and actor record X are conditional entry bounds; the signed offset vector has zero net displacement.
